findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 稱中國與台灣若爆發軍事衝突，將對在該地區的銷售與供應鏈造成重大不利影響
findings.excerpt: A military conflict between China and Taiwan would likely have a material adverse impact on our ability to sell products to customers in these areas and on our supply chain.

findings.claim: 2025 與 2024 年對中國客戶銷售約占總營收 4%
findings.excerpt: Our net sales to China-based customers represented approximately 4% of total revenues in 2025 and 2024, respectively.

findings.claim: 中國、印度、沙烏地要求在地供應商與在地製造，公司在這些國家製造有限，已損及數條產品線營收
findings.excerpt: Many countries, including China, India and Saudi Arabia, have bolstered laws or regulations requiring the use of local suppliers, personnel and in-country manufacturing

findings.claim: 歐洲國防採購愈來愈要求歐盟境內生產設施，無法滿足則可能無法投標新專案
findings.excerpt: requirements to have production facilities in the EU are becoming more common to win contracts. If we are unable to respond to these requirements, we may be unable to bid on new programs

findings.claim: PolicyRisk 摘要：公司揭露中國軸風險含稀土與永磁限制、關稅、出口管制收緊
findings.excerpt: On the China axis it flagged Beijing's restrictions on rare earth minerals and permanent magnets used in its products, new and proposed tariffs, tightening export controls
